home.statsTitle: Experience on the ground, not from behind a screen

home.processLead: No surprises. At every stage you know where your goods are and what you have paid.

process.step1Title: You tell us what you need
process.step1Body: Product, quantity, budget and destination country. We reply on WhatsApp within one working day.
process.step2Body: We find the right factories, negotiate the price, and send you a detailed quote with the full landed cost.
process.step3Body: A site visit to the factory and an inspection of the sample and the goods before shipping. You get the photos and the report.
process.step4Body: Sea or air freight, customs clearance, and delivery to your warehouse. We stay with it until you have the goods.

home.blogLead: Practical articles about importing from China, written in Arabic.

home.categoriesTitle: Whatever you need in China, in one place
home.categoriesLead: From the first product search to a registered company, a bank account and a work visa. Pick the area you need.
home.journeyLead: Tap any step to see what happens there and which service covers it. Start anywhere; most clients do not begin at step one.

1.title: The idea
1.body: You bring a product or a plan. We talk it through honestly: what it costs, how long it takes, and whether China is the right place to do it.

2.title: Market and product research
2.body: Demand, competitors, price points and the factories that already make it, before any money moves.

3.title: Trademark
3.body: China is first-to-file. Registering your brand before a factory or a competitor does is the cheapest protection you will ever buy.

4.title: Company setup
4.body: A registered company with a licence, a registered address and a bank account, in the city that suits your business.

5.title: Structure and residence
5.body: Who signs, who owns what, and the work permit and residence card if you or your staff will live in China.

6.title: Accounting and compliance
6.body: Monthly books, tax filings and the annual report, done by licensed accountants, so the company stays in good standing.

7.title: Find the supplier
7.body: Verified factories, not trading companies pretending to be one. Samples, comparisons and negotiation in Chinese.

8.title: Production and quality
8.body: Production followed on the ground, inspections before you pay and before it ships, with photographs and a report.

9.title: Shipping
9.body: Sea, air or rail, chosen for your timeline and budget, with one landed price instead of five invoices.

10.title: Customs clearance
10.body: Export paperwork in China and import clearance at your end, prepared so nothing waits at the port.

11.title: Local delivery
11.body: From the port to your door, arranged and tracked until it is signed for.

12.title: Your warehouse
12.body: Goods delivered, company running, next order easier than the first. The road loops back to step seven.

home.consultLead: A video or WhatsApp call with someone who is in China and has done this hundreds of times. You leave with a plan and real numbers.
home.consultNote: The fee is credited against any service you go on to book with us.

fields.name: Full name
fields.goals: What would you like to achieve?
fields.goalsHint: Product, market, budget, timing — whatever you already know.
fields.timezoneHint: So we can suggest a time that works for both of us.
fields.channel: How would you like to talk?
fields.fullName: Full name of the legal representative
fields.fullNameHint: Exactly as written in the passport.
fields.chinesePhone: Do you have a Chinese phone number?
fields.companyNamesHint: Three options, in English and Chinese if you have them. Avoid names of countries, oceans or famous people.
fields.businessScopeHint: Be specific: “clothing — women’s and children’s wear”, not “trading”. Food and medical goods need extra licences.
fields.registeredCapitalHint: Not paid up front — it can be deposited within five years. Above 15,000 USD is recommended if you want a residence permit.
fields.addressOptionHint: A physical office is required if you will live in China. Otherwise a virtual address with a formal lease works.
fields.needResidence: Do you want a work visa and residence permit?
fields.needResidenceHint: Affects the address type and the recommended capital.
fields.shareholdersHint: One per line: full name — nationality — percentage.
fields.decisionMakerHint: The person with authority to sign for the company.
fields.extras: Would you also like us to arrange…
fields.passportNumberHint: Letters and digits only, as printed.
fields.passportExpiryHint: Must be valid for at least six months after arrival.
fields.applyCity: Where will you apply for the visa?
fields.applyCityHint: City and country of the Chinese embassy or visa centre.
fields.purposeHint: Meetings, factory visits, exhibitions — a sentence or two.
fields.speedHint: Normal issue takes up to 29 working days.
fields.visitedChina: Have you been to China before?
fields.previousVisa: Have you held a Chinese visa before?
fields.hasChineseCompany: Do you have a company in China?
fields.hasChineseCompanyHint: A work visa needs an employer in China. If you have none, we can register one for you.
fields.educationHint: The higher the qualification, the stronger the application.
fields.familyMemberHint: Their relationship to you and their status in China (work permit, residence, citizen).
fields.productNameHint: In English if possible, plus the Arabic name.
fields.productLinkHint: A listing on Alibaba, Amazon or anywhere else that shows what you mean.
fields.specsHint: Colour, size, material, certification, packaging — everything the factory will ask.
fields.volumeCbmHint: If you know it. Otherwise give carton dimensions in the notes.
fields.readyDateHint: When the goods will be ready at the supplier.
fields.legalRepInChina: Can the legal representative travel to China?
fields.legalRepInChinaHint: Most banks require the legal representative in person. Some accept remote opening.
fields.tradingCountriesHint: Where you export to or import from.
fields.monthlyVolumeHint: Banks ask. An estimate is enough.
fields.hasAlipayBusiness: Do you have a business Alipay account?
fields.hasAlipayBusinessHint: AliExpress requires one. We can open it for you.
fields.firstProducts: The first products you want to list
fields.brandNameChineseHint: If you have one. Registering a Chinese version is strongly recommended.
fields.classesHint: Trademarks are registered per class of goods. Unsure? Leave it blank and we will advise.
fields.productsHint: What the brand sells, e.g. “perfume and cosmetics”.
fields.existingRegistrationHint: In your own country or internationally.
